source_evidence.quote: Blockquotes can have nested paragraphs. In our original mobiledoc editor we parsed all of the nested paragraphs into a single blockquote separating each paragraph with two line breaks.
source_evidence.inference: Paragraph children have an explicit conversion path; whether this avoids the reported text loss is a HYPOTHESIS. The root cause of the loss was not identified.

deliverable.alternative_reported_by_user: https://forum.ghost.org/t/59100 post 2 (Charlie_X): wrap HTML in <!--kg-card-begin: html--> / <!--kg-card-end: html--> comments, which imports it as an HTML card (it is then not an editable quote)
